module_title: Economic Survey - Social Progress, Innovation & External Sector
introduction: This advanced level explores micro-analytics, including the World Bank's revised poverty lines, social sector expenditure, global remittance rankings, and India's strides in deep-tech and space.

core_concepts.title: Social Services Expenditure
core_concepts.description: Government spending on education, healthcare, and social security continues to rise. Social service expenditure has increased to 7.9% of GDP (up from 7.7% the previous year).

core_concepts.title: Sharp Decline in Poverty (World Bank Metrics)
core_concepts.description: The World Bank revised the extreme poverty line from $2.15 to $3.00 per day (PPP). Even by this higher standard, Extreme Poverty in India has plummeted to just 5.3%.

core_concepts.title: Global Leader in Remittances
core_concepts.description: India remains the world's top remittance recipient, securing $135.4 billion. This massive inflow plays a critical role in balancing India's Current Account Deficit (CAD), which stands at just 0.8%.

core_concepts.title: Innovation and Startups
core_concepts.description: India has leaped from the 66th position (in 2019) to the 38th position in the Global Innovation Index (GII). Furthermore, India ranks 6th globally in patents and 4th in trademarks.

core_concepts.title: AI and Space Technology
core_concepts.description: The survey advocates for 'decentralized and application-driven' AI systems. In space, India has become the 4th nation globally to achieve autonomous satellite docking capabilities (SpaDeX).

important_entities.name: DISCOMs (Distribution Companies)
important_entities.significance: Power DISCOMs registered a positive Net Profit After Tax (PAT) of ₹2,701 crore for the first time, marking a massive structural reform in the power sector.

important_entities.name: Geopolitical Headwinds
important_entities.significance: The survey warns that rising protectionism, high tariffs, and stricter immigration controls in developed nations could negatively impact India's exports and remittances.

important_entities.name: National Nuclear Energy Mission
important_entities.significance: Launched with a massive allocation (₹20,000 crore) to reduce dependency on critical minerals during the country's clean energy transition.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Do not rely on outdated statistics. The Female Labour Force Participation Rate (FLFPR) has risen sharply to 41.7%, and the Unemployment Rate (UR) has dropped to 4.8%. Examiners often use older, negative stats to trick students.

While FDI inflows stood at $81 billion, the survey explicitly notes that FDI remains 'tepid' (below its true potential) despite strong macroeconomic fundamentals. Do not classify the FDI trend as an 'unprecedented boom'.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Memorize India's jump in the Global Innovation Index (GII): from rank 66 (2019) to rank 38 currently.

exam_strategy_tips: For UPSC Mains, use the '5.3% extreme poverty' (World Bank $3.00 benchmark) stat to substantiate answers on inclusive growth and welfare schemes.
Expect MCQs in Science & Tech sections regarding 'SpaDeX' (Space Docking) and the National Nuclear Energy Mission's 100 GW target.
